title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #7

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does it mean to acknowledge God's power? (1 mark)
   A. To admit that our strength comes from Him and thank Him
   B. To boast about ourselves
   C. To hide our talents
   D. To ignore God

2. Which fruit is shown by walking away instead of hitting back? (1 mark)
   A. Envy
   B. Greed
   C. Self-control
   D. Pride

3. Where were the ten men when they called to Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. At a distance
   B. Right beside Him
   C. In the temple
   D. In their homes

4. What does it mean to repent? (1 mark)
   A. To pretend nothing happened
   B. To be sorry for sin and turn away from it
   C. To run away
   D. To blame others

5. What did Jesus say the temple should be called? (1 mark)
   A. A palace
   B. A market
   C. A house of prayer
   D. A school

6. Who is your cousin? (1 mark)
   A. The child of your aunt or uncle
   B. Your father's father
   C. Your mother's sister
   D. Your teacher

7. Who asked Balaam to curse the Israelites? (1 mark)
   A. Joshua
   B. King Balak
   C. Pharaoh
   D. Herod

8. Which choice affects other people besides yourself? (1 mark)
   A. Choosing which shoe to wear first
   B. Littering the school compound
   C. Choosing a song you like
   D. Choosing your favourite colour

9. Which of these is personal information to protect? (1 mark)
   A. A favourite song
   B. The colour of the sky
   C. The weather
   D. Your home address

10. What did Jesus overturn in the temple? (1 mark)
   A. The windows
   B. Tables of the money changers
   C. The altar
   D. The doors

11. What does "holy" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Pure, perfect and set apart
   B. Old
   C. Rich
   D. Fast

12. Which verse says that truthful lips endure for ever? (1 mark)
   A. Acts 2:38
   B. Proverbs 1:7
   C. John 3:16
   D. Proverbs 12:19

13. What does being assertive mean? (1 mark)
   A. Being rude
   B. Being silent
   C. Saying no to wrong firmly and politely
   D. Fighting

14. What is one result of lying? (1 mark)
   A. Loss of trust
   B. Better marks
   C. More friends
   D. Peace of mind

15. Which of these is an emotional need? (1 mark)
   A. A new pair of shoes
   B. A meal
   C. A pencil
   D. Someone to listen

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Give three ways in which God helps us today. (3 marks)

17. Describe four ways of growing the fruit of the Spirit. (4 marks)

18. Explain the meaning of "Give us today our daily bread". (3 marks)

19. Explain why sexual purity is important and how children can begin to live a holy life like Mary. (5 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — To admit that our strength comes from Him and thank Him
   Acknowledging means to accept and thank.

2. C — Self-control
   Self-control is controlling actions.

3. A — At a distance
   They stood at a distance and called out.

4. B — To be sorry for sin and turn away from it
   Repentance includes turning away from wrong.

5. C — A house of prayer
   Matthew 21:13 says, "My house will be called a house of prayer."

6. A — The child of your aunt or uncle
   Cousins are the children of your uncles and aunts.

7. B — King Balak
   Numbers 22 says that Balak, king of Moab, sent for Balaam.

8. B — Littering the school compound
   Littering makes the compound dirty for everyone.

9. D — Your home address
   Never share your address online.

10. B — Tables of the money changers
   Matthew 21:12 says He overturned the tables.

11. A — Pure, perfect and set apart
   God is holy because He never does wrong.

12. D — Proverbs 12:19
   Proverbs 12:19 says this.

13. C — Saying no to wrong firmly and politely
   Assertive means standing for what is right.

14. A — Loss of trust
   People stop trusting a liar.

15. D — Someone to listen
   Emotional needs include comfort and friendship.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: He gives courage, wisdom, the power to forgive, healing and protection, and talents.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: Pray, read the Bible, practise one fruit at a time, ask for encouragement, say sorry and try again.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way up to 4.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: We ask God to give us what we need each day, such as food. We depend on Him and we thank Him for what we have.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for needs, 1 for food or daily, 1 for thanks or dependence.

19. (5 marks)
   Answer: The body is a gift from God, and sexual relations are meant for marriage. Purity keeps us safe and honours God. Children can begin by respecting their bodies, avoiding harmful places and media, obeying parents, praying and saying no to wrong.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for body as gift, 1 for marriage, 1 for honouring God, 1 for respecting body or avoiding harm, 1 for a prayer or obedience.
